description: This is a Bash shell script that generates a U-Boot FIT (Flattened Image Tree) image source (.its) file. It supports multi-configuration, multi-image, and signing options for creating bootable firmware images including kernel, device tree, and ramdisk images.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command-line options for the script.

methods.name: array_check
methods.description: Checks if an array index is within valid bounds.

methods.name: array_put
methods.description: Assigns or appends a value to an array element.

methods.name: array_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an array element.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line options and arguments to configure image generation.

methods.name: value_sanity_chk
methods.description: Validates options for signature, hash, and compression algorithms.

methods.name: emit_its
methods.description: Writes sections of the .its file for different parts of the image, such as start, images, configurations, and end sections.

methods.name: emit_kernel
methods.description: Outputs a kernel image node in the .its file.

methods.name: emit_fdt
methods.description: Outputs a device tree blob node in the .its file.

methods.name: emit_ramdisk
methods.description: Outputs a ramdisk node in the .its file.

methods.name: emit_signature
methods.description: Outputs signature subnodes for images based on specified algorithms and keys.

methods.name: emit_config
methods.description: Outputs configuration nodes with associated images and signatures.

methods.name: remove_prefix_space
methods.description: Removes leading spaces from a string.

methods.name: emit_image_nodes
methods.description: Generates image nodes and their subnodes (kernel, fdt, ramdisk) in the .its file.

methods.name: emit_configuration_nodes
methods.description: Generates configuration nodes and their subnodes in the .its file.
